mapper.sql: p.id, p.author_id, p.happened_at, left(p.content, 140) as excerpt, p.mood, p.visibility, u.display_name, (select m.url from post_media m where m.post_id = p.id order by m.sort_order, m.id limit 1) as cover_url
mapper.select: select from post p join app_user u on u.id = p.author_id where p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and p.status = 'PUBLISHED' order by p.happened_at desc, p.id desc
select from post p join app_user u on u.id = p.author_id order by p.happened_at desc, p.id desc
select p.id, p.author_id, u.display_name, p.content, p.happened_at, p.mood, p.location, p.visibility, p.status, p.comments_open from post p join app_user u on u.id = p.author_id where p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into post (author_id, content, happened_at, mood, location, visibility, status, comments_open) values (#{authorId}, #{content}, #{happenedAt}, #{mood}, #{location}, #{visibility}, #{status}, #{commentsOpen})
mapper.update: update post set content = #{content}, happened_at = #{happenedAt}, mood = #{mood}, location = #{location}, visibility = #{visibility}, status = #{status}, comments_open = #{commentsOpen} where id = #{id}
